item.title: Winter Storm Prompts Cancellation of In-Person Classes
item.description: Blizzard-like conditions brought by a winter storm caused the cancellation of in-person classes on Monday for the first time since 2015. Teachers provided instruction via Microsoft Teams, Zoom, or asynchronously, while athletics and off-campus events were cancelled for the day, according to Susan Esty, Dean of Students.
